text:
aj: quick heads-up — billing flagged a customer seeing extra token charges after retries + toolcalls. can we triage?

nina: which customer/org? any logs? :eyes:

aj: org 5342-prod. flow looks like: client -> model call (with toolcall) -> model times out -> client retries -> second request completes but toolcall executes twice and gets billed twice.

derek: are we deduping by idempotency key? reservation logic should avoid double-consuming reserved tokens.

sophia: we reserve prompt tokens on request start to prevent bursts. tool calls are billed on completion. sounds like retries bump reservations but toolcall replay isn't idempotent.

aj: log snippet pasted below:
```
2026-03-10T15:02:11Z Request id=abc token_est=120 reserved=120
2026-03-10T15:02:13Z Retry id=abc-1 token_est=140 reserved=260
2026-03-10T15:02:14Z Toolcall invoked tool_run=tr-987 tokens=80
2026-03-10T15:02:15Z Completed tokens=220 billed=300
```

nina: so reserved increases on retry and we never dedupe. client-provided request_id would solve it but some LBs rewrite ids.

derek: proposed fixes:
- make reservations keyed to idempotency-key (prefer client header X-Request-Id)
- buffer toolcall token charges until commit, only decrement reservation on final commit
- add console UX: show "tentative reservations" vs "final billed" per request to make this visible to customers

sophia: UX visibility is high priority. customers keep asking why billing spikes during retries. but note: holding reservations across retries may make per-org burst usage look higher and could trigger burst caps incorrectly. need to reconcile with burst control logic.

aj: another symptom: some streaming completions got counted as prompt tokens in telemetry, which skews prompt vs completion breakdown in dashboards.

nina: yeah that smells like the tokenizer/metrics mapping bug we introduced when moving postprocessing to platform side — stream EOF mapping missed.

derek: quick short-term patch: ensure tokenizer returns explicit triple (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, tool_tokens) and platform uses those values directly. canary to 2% first.

aj: action items:
- nina: open SDK/SDK docs PR to require idempotency header and add guidance for LBs
- derek: prototype reservation-by-idempotency-key + buffered toolcall commit flow (design doc pls)
- sophia: console changes for tentative vs final and rollout safety check (pause rollout if metering delta > 5%)
- ops: add alert for per-request delta >= 10% between reserved and billed

metering-bot: alert rule created: metering.delta.per_request > 0.1 for 1h -> page oncall

nina: i'll start PR for idempotency docs and add migration notes for partners using custom load balancers.

aj: tagging @derek and @sophia for follow-ups. thanks folks :thumbsup:
